rebind_hints: LOTIS-5: Phase 3 randomized confirmatory trial of loncastuximab tesirine + rituximab vs R-GemOx in 2L+ ASCT-ineligible DLBCL; primary endpoint PFS; N=420; ~262 PFS events; topline 2Q 2026 (likely NCT04384484).

results.evidence: The flagged 'Primary endpoint: PFS' claim is explicitly attached to LOTIS-5, a Phase 3 randomized 420-patient confirmatory trial of ZYNLONTA + rituximab with 262 prespecified PFS events — not the bound NCT04970901, which is a Phase 1 non-randomized 200-patient dose-escalation safety study of ZYNLONTA + glofitamab with DLT/TEAE primaries. Divergence on phase (1 vs 3), endpoint family (safety/DLT vs efficacy/PFS), regimen (glofit combo vs rituximab combo), and design (non-randomized vs 1:1 randomized) — multiple axes — indicates the wrong NCT was bound.
